mechanism.validator_requirement: set(traces_by_field) must equal {observations[i] for each observation} ∪ {candidate_promise_texts[j] for each promise}
mechanism.model_behaviour: traces every observation, never traces any candidate promise
mechanism.prompt_instruction_verbatim: Every observation and candidate promise needs a source_trace entry.
why_the_model_misses_it: 指令原文是抽象的「Every ... needs an entry」，没有说明 field 必须逐条为 observations[N] / candidate_promise_texts[M] 的精确编号引用；
同一句把「an entry」写成单数，示意一字段一条，模型据 observation 数量给了 4 条恰好一一对应的 trace；
schema 示例里 field 的值是单条字面量 "observations[0] or candidate_promise_texts[0]"，无法推出「两个集合都要逐条覆盖」；
本批真实输出中 observations[2]/[3] 与两条 promise 文本高度重合，模型很可能据此认为 observation 的 trace 已经「覆盖」了承诺。

was_the_model_required_to_trace_each_pro.by_the_prompt_implicitly: yes, but only via the abstract sentence at line 37, which the model does not operationalise into per-promise field references

diagnostic_answers.prompt_source_trace_instruction_verbatim: Every observation and candidate promise needs a source_trace entry. Cite only supplied source identifiers.

schema_repair_retry_shape.note: tools/verification/live_smoke.py calls provider.extract_with_metadata once per attempt and never uses BoundedCandidateExtractor, so the schema-repair prompt at model/prompts/candidate_extraction.py:49-63 was NEVER exercised by this batch. The two attempts in one tool run are two independent fresh calls with the same initial prompt, not an initial+repair pair.
schema_repair_retry_shape.observed_shape_across_4_real_calls: identical structure every time: schema fully valid (adapter parsed, candidate_schema=PASS), 4 observations, 2 promises, exactly 4 traces covering observations only

cross_line_remap_effect_on_this_defect.remap_detail: fixtures/demo-cases.json declared S00001_IMG_OVERVIEW / S00001_IMG_PUMP / S00001_IMG_PACKAGE; the accepted registry handoff/a/images-manifest.json registers S00001_IMG_PRODUCT_OVERVIEW / S00001_IMG_PUMP_DETAIL / S00001_IMG_PACKAGE_CONTEXT. live_smoke.py binds by file_name and sends the registry's IDs.
why_not: the three image evidence IDs the model had to cite appear verbatim in the [trusted_source_ids] header of the request text;
the model cited two of them correctly (S00001_IMG_PUMP_DETAIL, S00001_IMG_PACKAGE_CONTEXT), proving it could read and resolve them;
the defect is confined to the candidate_promise_texts collection; no image trace is missing in any of the 4 real calls.

request_construction_verified.conclusion: the model was shown complete and correct input; nothing required for a promise trace was missing from the request

counterfactual_proof.method: took the model's verbatim candidate from the byte-verified capture, appended ONLY the two missing promise traces, and re-ran validate_candidate_sources with the production SanitizedModelInput
counterfactual_proof.conclusion: trace coverage is the ONLY unmet condition. Every other rule — image binding, source-type match, AGENT-quote containment, duplicate detection, image-instruction exclusion — already passes with the model's real output.
counterfactual_proof.implication: the defect is a prompt-wording gap, not a validator that demands the impossible

criterion_1_real_chat_plus_image_to_extr.cached_result_note: model_metadata is absent by design on a rejected run; the tool must not publish an ExtractedJourney it never built
criterion_1_real_chat_plus_image_to_extr.detail: HTTP 200, schema-valid candidate, then the server-side source validator refuses it. This is the same outcome as the previous round and is now root-caused.

criterion_3_twenty_second_budget.detail: see second_defect below — the tool sums every attempt into model_bound_ms, so two ~10 s calls exceed the 20 s verdict even though no single request did

second_defect_budget_accounting.blocking_reason: even after the prompt is fixed, the default --attempts 2 (DEFAULT_ATTEMPTS, line 101) would accumulate two ~10 s calls into model_bound_ms and still report BUDGET_EXCEEDED

frozen_semantics.docs_reference: docs/05-api-and-ui.md freezes the 20 s analysis budget
frozen_semantics.extractor_enforcement: BoundedCandidateExtractor(total_timeout_seconds=...) bounds one initial call plus at most one schema repair (backend/src/covenia_b/model/extraction.py:129-138)
frozen_semantics.therefore: the 20 s verdict is a per-request bound; summing N independent measurement attempts is not the same measurement

second_defect_budget_accounting.why_not_fixed: it is a measurement-semantics change to a tracked deliverable's evidence, and fixing it cannot turn criterion 1 green while the prompt gap is open. Per the repair instruction this was reported instead of changed unilaterally; it is fully inside the whitelist and can be applied immediately once authorised.

proposed_minimal_change.line_1046: keep model_bound_started as the whole-run accumulator and add per-attempt start/stop around each _run_attempt call
proposed_minimal_change.line_1060: after appending the AttemptRecord, store the attempt's model-bound ms on the record (a new AttemptRecord field, e.g. model_bound_ms)
proposed_minimal_change.line_1072_to_1079: set run.model_bound_ms to the accepted attempt's model_bound_ms (or the max single-attempt model-bound time when rejected); add document['budget']['model_bound_ms_total_run'] = the cumulative value

proposed_minimal_change.risk: LOW — it changes only which number the budget verdict reads; it cannot manufacture an accepted candidate, and every attempt's raw wall/provider ms stay in the artifact

第 37 行改为可操作的计数式表述，例如："Emit one source_trace entry for EVERY element of observations and EVERY element of candidate_promise_texts. If observations has 4 elements and candidate_promise_texts has 2, source_trace must contain 6 entries with fields observations[0..3] and candidate_promise_texts[0..1]. A trace for an observation does not also cover a promise."
